unlisted_practices: Establish automated drift detection systems to enable large-scale monitoring of AI models deployed in pathology departments.
Have pathology quality societies collect and share diverse test datasets for validating AI models.
Define operating procedures that include periodic expert pathologist review and assessment of AI systems, even where automated monitoring is in place.
Establish robust and portable validation protocols and quality management systems for lab-developed AI models.
Add AI competencies such as informatics, model development and validation, critical assessment, and ethical/legal issues to pathology residency training.
Ensure laboratories using open-source models adopt them as the true manufacturer, through retraining, local validation, and ongoing monitoring.
Ensure complete transparency regarding the AI model's performance characteristics and limitations.
Have regulators provide clear, practical guidance enabling pathologists to develop and implement lab-developed AI safely.
Foster collaboration among academic institutions, pathology departments, and professional organizations to share best practices and resources for lab-developed AI.
